messages:
clare: Heads-up 1 Andromeda interview done. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/andromeda. Need: redlined transcript, approved public quote, embargo timing, hero clip (30s), 3 webinar bites, EN/FR captions, tracking UTMs, and demo routing.

ben: Great. They said "we halved inference spend" on the call. Legal will want softened phrasing for public. Also asked to include their logo on the landing.

sasha: I'll cut the hero 30s and the 3x15s webinar clips. Can ops confirm caption vendor? We need FR captions within 48h.

legal-bot: Automated check: NDA on file; `customer-release-v2` required. Public copy must not contain internal IDs, hostnames, or raw telemetry (exact p95/p99). Recommend phrasing: "reduced inference costs by ~50%". If customer insists on exact numbers, require a signed telemetry addendum. Final legal sign-off requires the redlined transcript attached to the release form.

clare: Thanks. @ben please send two public-safe quote options to the customer: (1) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% while improving latency." (2) "We saw meaningful cost and latency improvements after moving to Redwood." Ask them to confirm public wording and logo usage.

ben: Sent both options to Andromeda, BCC'd legal. Asked for approval in 48h.

sasha: Caption vendor options: QuickSub (24h auto+QC) or LocalVoice (72h human). Ops, pick one for speed.

ops-bot: Recommend QuickSub to meet 48h window. Will stage UTMs and pixel after embargo confirmation. Example landing URL:
```
https://redwood.ai/andromeda?utm_campaign=andromeda_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social
```
Routing rule: `lead_tag=cs-benchmark` -> assign to AE Micha (micha@redwood.ai), priority high-touch.

ben: Customer replied: approves option 1 and okayed logo. Signed release uploaded to Drive.

clare: Great. Ben, attach the redlined transcript to the release and upload. Sasha, start edits once clips are ready.

sasha: Uploaded hero + clips to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/andromeda/assets (hero_30s.mp4, bite_15_1.mp4, bite_15_2.mp4, bite_15_3.mp4). EN captions included; FR captions requested from QuickSub.

ops-bot: QuickSub confirmed ETA 24h for FR captions. Pixel and HubSpot flow staged for testing; will go live at embargo.

legal-bot: Received redlined transcript and signed release. Final review in progress.

legal-bot: Final legal sign-off: green. No PII, public phrasing OK, telemetry addendum not required.

clare: Embargo set for 2026-05-03 09:00 PT. Ops - schedule landing + social at embargo time and ensure UTMs + routing rules are live. Also please include `lead_tag=cs-benchmark` so Micha gets hot leads.

ops-bot: Scheduled landing publish and social queue for 2026-05-03 09:00 PT. UTMs and pixel live. Routing rules tested; AE Micha assigned.

ae-micha: I'll prep outreach templates and standby for demo alerts. Will monitor inbound leads post-launch and report any high-priority opportunities.

clare: Thanks team 60 Launch checklist closed once live. I'll follow up with the customer on publish day for any press/partner intros. :rocket:
